title: multi-model audit -> 5 defects found, 4 fixed, 1 measurement correction

models_and_areas.verdict: 3 findings F1/F2/F3; 4 areas held under concrete attack
2 P0 + 8 more; several verified-correct checks too
~2% padding proven by breaking the implementation
numbers cited no source -> STATUS rewritten

defects_fixed.defect: _early_pool_is_enough passed a full URL to registrable_domain(), which expects a host; every path became its own domain, so 6 pages on ONE host satisfied a 3-domain floor
defects_fixed.impact: guard certified single-source pools as deep+diverse, cancelled healthy slow providers, then diversify(strict=True) shrank below k
defects_fixed.gate1: CAUGHT - test fails on the mutant (early_stopped=True on a single-domain pool)

defects_fixed.defect: the recall/query_expanded pass runs a second _fuse into a throwaway outcome; its early_stopped was discarded
defects_fixed.impact: a timing-dependent partial result from the recall pass was cached for the full TTL
defects_fixed.fix: propagate alt_outcome.early_stopped into the main outcome

defects_fixed.found_by: lead (while strengthening a zero-assertion test qwen flagged)
defects_fixed.defect: check_ip returned early when allow_private_networks=True, BEFORE the BLOCKED_IPS metadata check
defects_fixed.impact: 169.254.169.254 / 168.63.129.16 / 100.100.100.200 were reachable whenever the private-network opt-in was enabled - the exact addresses whose purpose is to hand out instance credentials
defects_fixed.fix: move the metadata blocklist above the allow_private_networks early return

defects_fixed.defect: claimed 10 full-profile tools forward arguments; only asserted is_error is False
defects_fixed.fix: assert each forwarded argument appears in the result payload
defects_fixed.gate1: CAUGHT - sabotaging a stub to return a constant makes the test fail

defects_fixed.fix: each now asserts real behaviour (header presence, server bootstrap, explicit None, exact de-chunked bytes + size cap)

defects_fixed.defect: skips alone but failed in the full suite: the env guard only handled raised launch exceptions, not an error-status payload
defects_fixed.fix: also skip when status=error with no passages, still failing on a genuine product bug

measurement_corrections.defect: cycle1_final_latency.py called bare WebLens(); Settings() read TAVILY_API_KEY from .env and auto_include_tavily=True prepended tavily. A measurement labelled 'keyless' actually used Tavily.
measurement_corrections.correction: harness now pins tavily_api_key=None + auto_include_tavily=False and refuses to run if tavily appears in the chain
measurement_corrections.note: p50 1497.5ms is barely under the 1500ms gate - the honest margin is far thinner than previously reported

not_fixed.detail: SafeFetcher reuses caller headers across cross-host redirects; real callers are Tavily (Authorization) and Brave (X-Subscription-Token). Confirmed structurally at net/client.py:236 + :278-287; my own end-to-end repro was blocked first by DNS, so it stands as a code-read finding, not a reproduced one.
Stack Exchange key is a URL query param, so the full URL lands in cache meta and FetchError text
default allowed_hosts lacks a port wildcard so a real client gets 421; the documented workaround '*' disables DNS-rebinding protection

verified_correct_by_models: SSRF connect-time pinning (SafeNetworkBackend on both httpx pools; connect to validated dest.ip)
browser egress proxy rejected 12/12 hostile raw-socket cases
inbound MCP auth: 401/421/403 enforced, no scheme-case/bare-token/NUL/duplicate-header bypass, timing-safe compare
SQL fully parameterized; hostile FTS queries left schema and row counts intact
no live API key in any shipped report/evidence file (1067 files scanned)
